term.label: unspecified_indel

definition.text: A sequence alteration which includes an insertion or a deletion. This describes a sequence length change when the direction of the change is unspecified or when such changes are pooled into one category.

comments: This term is used when there is a change that is either an insertion or a deletion but it is unknown which event occurred.
